map.为什么要随机生成 Global ID？: Why generate the Global ID randomly?
map.RFC 4193 要求 ULA 的 40 位 Global ID 用随机算法生成: RFC 4193 requires the 40-bit Global ID of a ULA to be generated by a random algorithm rather than written by hand as fd00:0000:0000::/48. The goal is to make it all but impossible for two organizations' address spaces to overlap, so that VPN interconnects or company mergers never run into address conflicts.
